name: print-social-hand-drawn-line-figure-explainer-with-pink-highlights
title: Psychology explainer: pink title bar, black line-drawn walker and a timeline arrow
whatItIs: A white post with a pink rounded title bar, a black outline figure stretching an arm toward a dashed arc labelled 'rest', a timeline arrow split 'today' and 'later' with words about travel and choices, and pink crayon dashes and underlines. A pink outlined pill holds the handle.
whatItMeans: Light, human and clear; hand-drawn diagrams make a heavy idea approachable.
techniques: Illustrate a concept with a single line figure and a timeline.
Use pink crayon accents for emphasis.
Set labels in a handwritten face.
Keep the layout airy with a title bar and handle pill.

vocabulary.definition: A person drawn in a single outline.
An axis showing before and after.
An outlined capsule with the account name.
